newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's FIH to open 3 pct bond series.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's FIH to open 3 pct bond series.

text.p: Denmark's Finance for Danish Industry (FIH) said on Tuesday that it would offer tap issues of three percent bonds in one, two, three and four-year maturities to be listed on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange from April 29.
FIH director Niels Larsen said the paper would be sold at prevailing market prices in such quantity as the market determined.
"Its a tap issue and of course its up to the market. It could be a matter of billions of crowns but realistically we estimate that it could run into hundreds of millions," he told Reuters.
An FIH statement said that the loans would mature on December 15, 1998, 1999, 2000 and 2001 and that interest would be paid annually on December 15.
The issue period would run from April 29, 1997 to September 15 in the respective maturity years, it added.
